$comment: Known-flaky tests (omg ship gates). A failed CI job whose every failing vitest test matches an entry here, with no unhandled errors, failed suites or failing non-test step, is classified flaky: gates suggests `gh run rerun <id> --failed` and `gates --watch` reruns each run at most once. A test failing twice is a real failure. Source: .omc/skills/omg-release-runbook.md 'Known flaky tests'. `file` is repo-relative; `title` (required) is a substring of the full test title, so a file-level collection error never matches. The runbook's runtime-done-recovery entry is omitted: its done.json polling test was retired and no current test in that file has the briefly-malformed window.
